hero.title: Los Lagos Hotel
hero.subtitle: A small family-run hotel in the heart of El Calafate, combining simplicity, warmth, tranquillity, comfort and attentive, all-round service, just 3 minutes from the town centre, bars, restaurants and travel agencies.

about.title: A quiet base for exploring Southern Patagonia.
about.paragraph: The hotel has 14 double and triple rooms with private bathrooms, equipped with flat-screen TVs, central heating, free Wi-Fi, bed linen, towels and amenities. Guests can relax in the garden. Our simple breakfast includes tea and coffee, bread, croissants, butter and jams. Laundry service is available on request. A refrigerator, microwave and complimentary tea are available in the common areas. We welcome you like family and help you arrange your excursions.

rooms.title: Double or triple, standard or superior.
rooms.paragraph: 4 room types with heating, Wi-Fi, TV and breakfast included. Choose the one that best suits your trip.

experiences.title: The Perito Moreno glacier, within your reach.
experiences.paragraph: We are your base camp in El Calafate. The hotel arranges transfers and helps you plan every excursion across Patagonia.

location.title: In the heart of El Calafate.
location.paragraph: Nearby attractions include Laguna Nimez, the Lake Argentino waterfront, the Historical Interpretation Centre and Avenida del Libertador (200 m away), where you will find the National Parks Office, the Ice Bar, restaurants and shops. El Calafate Airport is 22 km away, and the bus terminal is 1.8 km from the hotel.
